title: Dispatcher Cleanup
description: Infrastructure cleanup of dispatchers: convert calcDispatcher eager imports to lazy, resolve cross-dispatcher action name collisions, add z.enum validation to mechanicalDesign and fluidThermal dispatchers, and add hook integration to cadDispatcher.

units.title: Convert 62 eager imports to lazy dynamic imports
units.description: Convert 62 eager top-level imports in calcDispatcher to lazy dynamic imports. Clean up ValidatedParams = any → proper union type. Remove 3 leaked non-action strings from ACTIONS array.
acceptance: 62 top-level imports converted to lazy dynamic imports
ValidatedParams type replaced with proper union type
3 leaked non-action strings removed from ACTIONS array

units.title: calcDispatcher lazy-load tests
units.description: Add 5+ tests verifying all calcDispatcher cases lazy-load correctly and produce correct results.
acceptance: Lazy loading verified for representative action sample

units.title: Audit and resolve 31 colliding action names
units.description: Audit 31 colliding action names across dispatchers. Namespace or deduplicate (e.g., calc_energy_analyze vs cam_energy_analyze). Update ToolRouter with disambiguated routes.

units.title: Replace z.string() with z.enum(ACTIONS)
units.description: Replace z.string() with z.enum(ACTIONS) in mechanicalDesignDispatcher and fluidThermalDispatcher for compile-time action validation.
acceptance: Both dispatchers use z.enum(ACTIONS) instead of z.string()

units.title: Add pre/post-calculation hooks to cadDispatcher
units.description: Add pre/post-calculation hooks to cadDispatcher matching the pattern used by other dispatchers.
